thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: OrionOps dedicated pool bring-up set for Thu 09:00 PT. Need quotas signed, final autoscale policy, and a clear load-test runbook. Who can own the runbook + smoke?
Tom (Solutions): I can own the runbook and lead the smoke. Need the test token + KMS thumbprint from the customer side.
Anika (PM): Noted renewal signal: Orion usage doubled month-over-month. They're expecting a 5x burst at cutover — recommend canary + stepped ramp and flag renewal risk as "moderate" until we validate.
Rob (EngInfra): For autoscale defaults I propose min=2 nodes, target_cpu=60%, queue_depth=200. Enable burst_pool fallback (committed) to avoid throttle events. I'll prepare an infra PR.
Lenora (SRE): Ops req: prime KV cache before the run. Plan: prefix-warm 10k samples, then ramp to 1k RPS -> 10k tokens/s over 20m for soak. I can drive the harness and capture metrics.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Tom, can you confirm test token location and perf team keys? Also we'll capture qualitative feedback during tests (2 quick questions post-smoke).
Tom (Solutions): Token stored in 1Password: ORION/dedicated-tests. KMS access request open (ticket #2345). I'll escalate if not granted by EOD Wed.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra/dedicated-autoscale#203 -> staging at 1788890000 by Rob
Rob (EngInfra): :raised_hands: deploying now. Will tag the PR with "orion-priming" and link the runbook.
Anika (PM): Suggest a 30-min enablement after smoke to walk Orion SREs through fallback policies and post-test checklist. We'll capture their feedback in a short postmortem.
Maya (CS): Action items: Tom — runbook + token check; Rob — autoscale config + PR; Lenora — load harness + smoke; Anika — renewal note + enablement session. I'll update customer timeline and send invites.
Tom (Solutions): I'll also author a short failure-scenario checklist: model fallback, region failover, burst-throttle behavior.
Lenora (SRE): One ask: eng-ml — can you provide a 30-prompt set reflecting Orion's top-10 intents by EOD Wed? Need it to validate quality under load.
Maya (CS): :thumbsup: pinging eng-ml for prompt set.
Rob (EngInfra): PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/203 (autoscale defaults). Tests scheduled Thu 09:00 PT.
Maya (CS): Last note for renewal team: success KPIs for marking go/no-go — error rate <2% and 95th-token-latency <350ms for 95% of traffic during the smoke. If we meet those, tag as green for renewal.
Anika (PM): Added KPIs to QBR doc and renewal thread. Will follow up with sales enablement for the post-smoke session.
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll post a single-run checklist and close the loop once KMS is approved.
